abilities.name: Permanent Cloak
abilities.text: Gain Stealth when out of combat for 3 seconds. Taking damage, attacking, using Abilities, or Channeling ends Stealth. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.text: Deal 200 damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Singularity Spike
abilities.text: Flings a Singularity Spike that sticks to the first enemy hit. Deals 240 damage after 1 second and Slows the enemy by 40% for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.text:
Teleport to the target location.

Using this Ability does not break Stealth.

abilities.name: Might Of The Nerazim
abilities.text:
Activate to cast an untalented version of Zeratul's most recently used Basic Ability, dealing 50% less damage.

Passive: After using an Ability, Zeratul's next Basic Attack within 6 seconds deals 30% more damage.

abilities.name: Void Prison
abilities.text: Slows time in an area to a near standstill, placing allies and enemies in Time Stop for 5 seconds. Zeratul is not affected.

1.name: Greater Cleave
1.text: Increases the radius of Cleave by 33%.

1.name: Shadow Hunter
1.text:
Quest: Gather Regeneration Globes to lower the Mana cost of Blink by 3, up to 45.

Reward: Upon gathering 15 Regeneration Globes, Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Blink by 1.5 seconds.

1.name: Move Unseen
1.text: Reduce the cooldown of Permanent Cloak by 1 second. Gain 30% Movement Speed while Stealthed.

4.name: Rending Cleave
4.text: Cleave deals an additional 40% damage over 3 seconds.

4.name: Psionic Strength
4.text: Dealing damage to enemy Heroes increases all damage dealt by 6% for 3 seconds, stacking up to 30%.

4.name: Darkness Descends
4.text:
Activate to gain 40% Attack Speed for 5 seconds.

Passive: Gain 20% Attack Speed.

7.name: Wormhole
7.text: After 1.25 seconds, reactivate Blink to return to the point where it was cast from within 4 seconds.

7.name: Seeker in the Dark
7.text: Singularity Spike takes 50% longer to explode. It can be reactivated to teleport to the target, granting 30% increased Move Speed for 3 seconds.

7.name: Warp Skirmisher
7.text: Vorpal Blade gains a 2nd charge. Teleporting to an enemy with Vorpal Blade or entering Permanent Cloak causes Zeratul's next Basic Attack to deal 50% more damage.

10.name: Might Of The Nerazim
10.text:
Activate to cast an untalented version of Zeratul's most recently used Basic Ability, dealing 50% less damage.

Passive: After using an Ability, Zeratul's next Basic Attack within 6 seconds deals 30% more damage.

10.name: Void Prison
10.text: Slows time in an area to a near standstill, placing allies and enemies in Time Stop for 5 seconds. Zeratul is not affected.

13.name: Shroud of Adun
13.text: Zeratul gains a Shield equal to 20% of his Maximum Health over 3 seconds while under Permanent Cloak.

13.name: Mending Strikes
13.text: Basic Attacks heal for 35% of the damage dealt.

13.name: Spell Shield
13.text:
Every 30 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 50%.

Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

16.name: Master Warp-Blade
16.text: Every third consecutive Basic Attack against the same target deals 125% more damage.

16.name: Void Slash
16.text: If Cleave hits more than one enemy Hero, it deals 40% increased damage and its cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds.

16.name: Sentenced to Death
16.text: Deal 25% increased damage to enemies while they are marked or Slowed by Singularity Spike.

20.name: Twilight Falls
20.text: Might of the Nerazim resets the cooldown of all Basic Abilities.

20.name: Unwavering Pressure
20.text: Singularity Spike no longer costs Mana. Basic Attacks against enemies reduce its cooldown by 1.25 seconds, double versus Heroes.

20.name: Shadow Stride
20.text: Reduce the cooldown of Vorpal Blade by 10 seconds. Casting Vorpal Blade grants Zeratul a Shield that absorbs up to 260 damage for 3 seconds.

20.name: Shadow Mending
20.text: Heal for 60% of Spell Damage dealt to Heroes.
